summary: Adds an explicit POST action to export only the selected site-owned form's active submissions; same-origin JSON checks and site Admin authorization remain mandatory.

Exports the historical form revision and schema-versioned columns, row ID/status/timestamps, consent version/time/text; expired submissions are excluded and malformed/unknown historic rows fail closed without partial output.
Bounds exports to 500 rows, 96 union columns, and 16 MiB; CSV cells are quoted, formula-like user text is neutralized, and the UTF-8 BOM/CRLF format is spreadsheet-friendly.
Sets private no-store and nosniff headers and records only row count, filtered flag and format in the success audit; no search text, submitted values, or consent text is copied to audit metadata.
Adds a keyboard-accessible Admin CSV button to the site-scoped inbox; it carries only the selected form and current filter and does not invoke page/form Save or Publish.
Adds admin-forms.html and admin-forms.js to the exact-source production Worker smoke hash set and updates the WEB-020 source/test crosswalk while retaining NOT_RECERTIFIED acceptance.
